**A2 (#231) GitLab governance CI — exploration gotcha: REQUIRED jobs can't stay pure bash on GitLab**

**What**: Mapped the exact surface A2 must mirror: GOVERNANCE_JOBS/REQUIRED_JOBS/DETECTION_JOBS (brain/scripts/vcs/governance-checks.mjs:24,33), the DETECTION two-case exit contract (ADR-0016 + issue-196-ci-context-impl/design.md Amendment 3), and ci-context.mjs's already-complete GitLab support (loadGitlabContext, ci-context.mjs:120-153).
**Why**: Grounding proposal/spec/design/ADR-draft/tasks for A2 (#231) — the GitLab CI pipeline that must consume ONLY ci-context.mjs, mirroring .github/workflows/governance.yml 1:1.
**Where**: brain/scripts/vcs/governance-checks.mjs, ci-context.mjs, phase-order-check.mjs, actor-check.mjs, brain-writes-reviewed.mjs, governance/run-check.mjs, .github/workflows/governance.yml, ci-context-drift-guard.test.mjs, brain/core/managed-paths.mjs, brain/core/config-migrations.mjs, docs/inbox/PLAN-adapters-v3.md (§Track A2, untracked draft plan already in repo), ADR-0016.
**Learned**: Non-obvious structural gotcha — on GitHub, REQUIRED jobs `issue-link` and `diff-size` are pure bash embedded directly in governance.yml, reading `${{ github.event.pull_request.body }}` / `.labels` from the Actions *event trigger payload* — they never call ci-context.mjs at all (only memory-gate/decision-gate go through run-check.mjs → loadContext()). GitLab CI has NO predefined-variable equivalent for MR description (confirmed via GitLab's own open feature request gitlab-org/gitlab#27598 — `CI_MERGE_REQUEST_DESCRIPTION` does not exist), and `CI_MERGE_REQUEST_LABELS` freezes at pipeline-creation time (stale — ADR-0016 explicitly says do not use it). So A2's GitLab `issue-link` and `diff-size` jobs CANNOT be pure bash mirrors of the GitHub bash — they MUST route through a Node wrapper calling `loadContext()` (fresh API-fetched body/labels) to stay correct, unlike their GitHub siblings. This is a real design decision the A2 proposal/design phase must resolve explicitly (new CLI runner extending run-check.mjs vs bash-calls-node-prints-JSON), not an oversight to silently "fix" by copy-pasting GitHub's bash. Also: `governance.approvedLabel` config key does not exist yet (not in config-migrations.mjs) — PLAN-adapters-v3.md already scoped it as an A2 deliverable (configurable per-provider label, default `status:approved` GH / `status::approved` scoped GitLab); adding it requires an additive config-migrations.mjs entry (schemaVersion bump, brain/core/ = Tier-2/L6 human-review gate) but is NOT itself a brain/core *logic* change, just config schema. Repo's own brain.config.json is stale (schemaVersion 0.3.0 vs migrations up to 0.5.0) — unrelated pre-existing drift, not in A2 scope.
